CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_ai_claim_need_location_turn_v1_service(p_account_id uuid, p_conversation_id uuid, p_client_request_id uuid, p_user_message text, p_location_context jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
 if p_location_context is null then raise exception 'LOCATION_CONTEXT_INVALID' using errcode='PT409';end if;
 return private.ai_claim_need_turn_context_v1(p_account_id,p_conversation_id,p_client_request_id,p_user_message,p_location_context);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_ai_claim_need_turn_v2_service(p_account_id uuid, p_conversation_id uuid, p_client_request_id uuid, p_user_message text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select private.ai_claim_need_turn_context_v1(p_account_id,p_conversation_id,p_client_request_id,p_user_message,null);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_ai_source_hash(aid uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select encode(extensions.digest(coalesce(private.worker_ai_source(aid),'null'::jsonb)::text,'sha256'),'hex');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_ai_turn_document(tid uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('turnId',t.turn_id,'conversationId',t.conversation_id,'clientRequestId',t.client_request_id,
  'state',case when state='PROCESSING' and lease_expires_at<statement_timestamp() then 'UNKNOWN_OUTCOME' else state end,
  'attemptId',attempt_id,'retryAllowed',false,'authoritative',true)
 from private.worker_ai_turns t where turn_id=tid;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ai_location_request_hash(cid uuid, body text, ctx jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(case when ctx is null
 then jsonb_build_object('conversationId',cid,'text',btrim(body))
 else jsonb_build_object('conversationId',cid,'text',btrim(body),'mode','locationReply','locationContext',ctx) end::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.closure_account_key(a uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ select hashtextextended('uskoci:account-closure:'||a::text,10121); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.closure_account_restricted(a uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ select exists(select 1 from private.account_closure_requests r where r.account_id=a
 and r.state in('READY','EXECUTING','FAILED','CLOSED')); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.data_export_projection_sha_v5()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ select encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(string_agg(signature||':'||md5(replace(p.prosrc,E'\r\n',E'\n')),E'\n' order by signature),'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') from unnest(array['private.data_export_dataset_catalog()','private.data_export_snapshot(uuid,uuid,jsonb,timestamptz)','private.data_export_scalar_v5(jsonb,text)','private.data_export_array_v5(jsonb,text)','private.data_export_worker_candidate_v5(jsonb)','private.data_export_worker_areas_v5(jsonb)','private.validate_worker_areas_v1(jsonb)','private.data_export_task_facts_v5(jsonb)','private.closure_taxonomy_inventory_v1()','private.closure_taxonomy_semantic_keys_v1()','private.closure_taxonomy_reset_sections_v1()','private.closure_taxonomy_scope_v1(text)','private.closure_taxonomy_semantic_v1(jsonb)','private.closure_taxonomy_project_v1(text,jsonb,uuid)','private.closure_taxonomy_export_rows_v1(uuid)','private.closure_taxonomy_export_catalog_v1()']) signature join pg_proc p on p.oid=to_regprocedure(signature) having count(*)=16 $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.data_export_snapshot(p_account_id uuid, p_receipt_id uuid, p_binding jsonb, p_cutoff timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 with configured as (select value as config from jsonb_array_elements(p_binding#>'{delivery,datasets}')),
 owned_rows as materialized (select 'account' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'email',t.email,'fullName',t.full_name,'city',t.city,'phone',t.phone,'activeMode',t.active_mode,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from public.app_accounts t where t.id=p_account_id
union all
select 'profiles' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'kind',t.kind,'displayName',t.display_name,'city',t.city,'headline',t.headline,'bio',t.bio,'status',t.profile_status,'skills',t.skills,'operatingCountryCode',t.operating_country_code,'dispatchEligibleSince',t.worker_dispatch_eligible_since,'dispatchClockSource',t.worker_dispatch_clock_source) as value from public.app_profiles t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'availabilityWindows' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'profileId',t.profile_id,'startsAt',t.starts_at,'endsAt',t.ends_at,'state',t.availability_state,'label',t.label) as value from public.profile_availability_windows t join public.app_profiles p on p.id=t.profile_id where p.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'availabilityRules' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'profileId',t.profile_id,'weekdays',t.weekdays,'startTime',t.start_time,'endTime',t.end_time,'startsOn',t.starts_on,'endsOn',t.ends_on,'active',t.active,'label',t.label) as value from public.profile_availability_rules t join public.app_profiles p on p.id=t.profile_id where p.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'calendar' as key,jsonb_build_object('agreementId',t.agreement_id,'startsAt',t.starts_at,'endsAt',t.ends_at,'state',t.state) as value from private.worker_calendar_events t where t.worker_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'needs' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'title',t.title,'description',t.description,'status',t.status,'revision',t.revision,'countryCode',t.task_country_code,'timezone',t.task_timezone,'executionMode',t.execution_location_mode,'startsAt',t.starts_at,'endsAt',t.ends_at,'requiredSlots',t.required_slots) as value from public.needs t where t.requester_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'needPrivate' as key,jsonb_build_object('needId',t.need_id,'exactAddress',t.exact_address,'accessNotes',t.access_notes,'latitude',t.exact_lat,'longitude',t.exact_lng,'resolvedPoints',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('slot',v->'slot','latitudeE6',v->'latitudeE6','longitudeE6',v->'longitudeE6','address',v->'address','accessNotes',v->'accessNotes') order by v->>'slot') from jsonb_array_elements(t.resolved_location#>'{value,points}') v),'[]'::jsonb)) as value from public.need_sensitive t join public.needs n on n.id=t.need_id where n.requester_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'responses' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'needId',t.need_id,'kind',t.response_kind,'status',t.status,'needRevision',t.submitted_against_need_revision,'priceRsd',t.price_rsd,'coveredSlots',t.covered_slots,'scopeNote',t.scope_note,'message',t.bounded_message,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from public.marketplace_responses t where t.worker_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownQuestions' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'needId',t.need_id,'question',t.question_text,'status',t.status,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.preselection_qa_questions t where t.asker_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownAnswers' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'questionId',t.question_id,'version',t.answer_version,'answer',t.answer_text,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.preselection_qa_answer_versions t where t.answered_by_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'agreements' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'needId',t.need_id,'status',t.status,'currentVersion',t.current_version,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from public.agreements t where t.requester_account_id=p_account_id or t.worker_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownAgreementMessages' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'agreementId',t.agreement_id,'body',t.body,'createdAt',t.created_at,'agreementVersion',t.agreement_version,'assetIds',to_jsonb(t.photo_asset_ids),'voiceAssetId',t.voice_asset_id) as value from public.agreement_messages t join public.agreements a on a.id=t.agreement_id where t.sender_account_id=p_account_id and (a.requester_account_id=p_account_id or a.worker_account_id=p_account_id)
union all
select 'consent' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'termsVersion',t.terms_version_label,'termsSha256',t.terms_content_sha256,'privacyVersion',t.privacy_version_label,'privacySha256',t.privacy_content_sha256,'acceptedAt',t.accepted_at) as value from public.account_legal_acceptance_events t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'notifications' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'role',t.recipient_role,'channel',t.channel,'state',t.state,'title',t.title,'body',t.body,'createdAt',t.created_at,'readAt',t.read_at) as value from public.notification_deliveries t where t.recipient_user_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'aiMessages' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'conversationId',t.conversation_id,'role',t.role,'content',t.body,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from public.ai_messages t join public.ai_conversations c on c.id=t.conversation_id where t.account_id=p_account_id and c.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'mediaMetadata' as key,jsonb_build_object('name',t.name,'createdAt',t.created_at,'bytesIncluded',false) as value from storage.objects t where t.bucket_id='profile-media' and split_part(t.name,'/',1)=p_account_id::text
union all
select 'exportRequests' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'kind',t.request_kind,'status',t.status,'requestedAt',t.requested_at,'completedAt',t.completed_at) as value from public.data_export_requests t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownAudit' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'eventType',t.event_type,'entityType',t.entity_type,'entityId',t.entity_id,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.marketplace_audit_log t where t.actor_user_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownAgreementReviews' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'agreementId',t.agreement_id,'rating',t.rating,'tags',t.tags,'createdAt',t.created_at,'comment',(select c.comment from private.agreement_review_comments_v1 c where c.review_id=t.id)) as value from private.agreement_reviews t join public.agreements a on a.id=t.agreement_id where t.reviewer_account_id=p_account_id and (a.requester_account_id=p_account_id or a.worker_account_id=p_account_id)
union all
select 'ownSafetyReports' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'needId',t.need_id,'agreementId',t.agreement_id,'category',t.category,'reason',t.reason,'narrative',t.narrative,'status',t.status,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.safety_reports t where t.reporter_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownBlocks' as key,jsonb_build_object('targetAccountId',t.blocked_account_id,'active',t.active,'revision',t.revision,'updatedAt',t.updated_at) as value from private.account_blocks t where t.blocker_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'workerAiDrafts' as key,jsonb_build_object('conversationId',t.conversation_id,'profileId',t.profile_id,'revision',t.revision,'safety',t.safety,'profile',private.data_export_worker_candidate_v5(t.candidate),'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.worker_ai_sessions t join public.ai_conversations c on c.id=t.conversation_id where t.account_id=p_account_id and c.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'workerAiReviews' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'conversationId',t.conversation_id,'revision',t.revision,'activate',private.data_export_scalar_v5(t.envelope->'activate','boolean'),'profile',private.data_export_worker_candidate_v5(t.envelope->'profile'),'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.worker_ai_reviews t join public.ai_conversations c on c.id=t.conversation_id where t.account_id=p_account_id and c.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'taskAiReviews' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'conversationId',t.conversation_id,'draftId',private.data_export_scalar_v5(t.envelope->'draftId','string'),'draftRevision',private.data_export_scalar_v5(t.envelope->'draftRevision','number'),'responseDeadline',private.data_export_scalar_v5(t.envelope->'responseDeadline','string'),'publicFacts',private.data_export_task_facts_v5(t.envelope->'publicProjection'),'privateFacts',private.data_export_task_facts_v5(t.envelope->'ownerPrivateProjection'),'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.ai_task_reviews t join public.ai_conversations c on c.id=t.conversation_id where t.account_id=p_account_id and c.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'taskAiFacts' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'conversationId',t.conversation_id,'facts',private.data_export_task_facts_v5(jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key',t.fact_key,'value',t.fact_value,'displayValue',t.display_value,'status',t.status)))) as value from public.ai_structured_facts t join public.ai_conversations c on c.id=t.conversation_id where c.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'workerAiTurns' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.turn_id,'conversationId',t.conversation_id,'state',t.state,'createdAt',t.created_at,'cancelledAt',t.cancelled_at) as value from private.worker_ai_turns t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'workerAiSaves' as key,jsonb_build_object('reviewId',t.review_id,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.worker_ai_saves t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'taskReviewCommands' as key,jsonb_build_object('reviewId',t.review_id,'needId',t.need_id,'needRevision',t.need_revision,'state',t.state,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.ai_task_review_commands t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'taskAiTurns' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.turn_id,'conversationId',t.conversation_id,'state',t.state,'cancelledAt',t.cancelled_at,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.ai_need_turn_commands t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'qaClassifications' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'needId',t.need_id,'needRevision',t.need_revision,'questionId',t.question_id,'type',t.command_type,'state',t.state,'outcome',t.outcome,'materiality',t.materiality,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.qa_ai_commands t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'qaCommands' as key,jsonb_build_object('type',t.command_type,'questionId',private.data_export_scalar_v5(t.result->'questionId','string'),'status',private.data_export_scalar_v5(t.result->'status','string'),'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.preselection_qa_commands t where t.actor_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownedMediaAssets' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'scope',t.scope,'conversationId',t.conversation_id,'profileId',t.profile_id,'state',t.state,'selected',t.selected,'width',t.width,'height',t.height,'byteSize',t.byte_size,'bytesIncluded',false,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.owned_media_assets t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'testAdmission' as key,jsonb_build_object('admittedAt',t.admitted_at,'retiredAt',t.retired_at) as value from private.ai_test_accounts_v5 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'testAllocations' as key,jsonb_build_object('kind',t.kind,'allocatedMaximumMicrousd',t.max_cost_microusd,'measuredProviderCharge',coalesce(t.settlement_basis='MEASURED',false),'settledMicrousd',t.settled_microusd,'settlementBasis',t.settlement_basis,'settledAt',t.settled_at,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.ai_test_reservations_v5 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'closureRequests' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'state',t.state,'revision',t.revision,'requestedAt',t.requested_at,'preparedAt',t.prepared_at,'closedAt',t.closed_at) as value from private.account_closure_requests t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'closureExecution' as key,jsonb_build_object('requestId',t.request_id,'state',t.state,'requestedAt',t.requested_at,'closedAt',t.closed_at) as value from private.closure_executions_v5 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'closureActions' as key,jsonb_build_object('kind',t.kind,'state',t.state,'dispatchedAt',t.dispatched_at,'verifiedAt',t.verified_at,'evidence',t.evidence) as value from private.closure_actions_v5 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownGroupMessages' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'groupId',t.group_id,'body',t.body,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value
 from private.group_messages_v5 t where t.sender_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownGroupMemberships' as key,jsonb_build_object('groupId',t.group_id,'agreementId',t.agreement_id,'joinedAt',t.joined_at,'endedAt',t.ended_at) as value
 from private.group_memberships_v5 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownLocationSnapshots' as key,jsonb_build_object('agreementId',c.agreement_id,'agreementVersion',c.agreement_version,
 'latitude',t.latitude,'longitude',t.longitude,'accuracyMeters',t.accuracy_meters,'capturedAt',t.captured_at,'sharedAt',t.shared_at) as value
 from private.agreement_location_points t join private.agreement_location_commands c using(actor_account_id,client_request_id)
 join public.agreements a on a.id=c.agreement_id where t.actor_account_id=p_account_id and a.worker_account_id=p_account_id and c.kind='SHARE' and c.state='COMMITTED'
union all
select 'ownLocationCommands' as key,jsonb_build_object('agreementId',t.agreement_id,'agreementVersion',t.agreement_version,'kind',t.kind,'state',t.state,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value
 from private.agreement_location_commands t join public.agreements a on a.id=t.agreement_id where t.actor_account_id=p_account_id and p_account_id in(a.requester_account_id,a.worker_account_id)
union all
select 'ownAcceptedTaskMedia' as key,jsonb_build_object('agreementId',t.agreement_id,'agreementVersion',t.agreement_version,'needId',t.need_id,'needRevision',t.need_revision,'state',t.state,'capturedAt',t.captured_at,'bytesIncluded',false,
 'assets',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('assetId',x->>'assetId','width',private.data_export_scalar_v5(x->'width','number'),'height',private.data_export_scalar_v5(x->'height','number'),'byteSize',private.data_export_scalar_v5(x->'byteSize','number')) order by ordinal),'[]') from jsonb_array_elements(t.assets) with ordinality as j(x,ordinal))) as value
 from private.agreement_media_snapshots_v5 t join public.agreements a on a.id=t.agreement_id where t.account_id=p_account_id and a.requester_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownSupportCases',jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'caseNumber',t.case_number::text,'channel',t.channel,'topic',t.topic,'title',t.title,'desiredOutcome',t.desired_outcome,'context',t.context,'status',t.status,'revision',t.revision,'createdAt',t.created_at,'updatedAt',t.updated_at) from private.support_cases_v5 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownSupportEvents',jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'caseId',t.case_id,'sequence',t.sequence::text,'kind',t.kind,'authorRole',t.author_role,'body',case when t.kind='SAFETY_REPORT' then (select narrative from private.safety_reports where id=c.safety_report_id) else t.body end,'decisionId',t.decision_id,'appealId',t.appeal_id,'createdAt',t.created_at) from private.support_events_v5 t join private.support_cases_v5 c on c.id=t.case_id where c.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownSupportDecisions',jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'caseId',t.case_id,'caseRevision',t.case_revision,'outcome',t.outcome,'reasonCode',t.reason_code,'explanation',t.explanation,'effect',t.effect,'evidenceIds',to_jsonb(t.evidence_ids),'priorDecisionId',t.prior_decision_id,'createdAt',t.created_at) from private.support_decisions_v5 t join private.support_cases_v5 c on c.id=t.case_id where c.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownSupportAppeals',jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'caseId',t.case_id,'decisionId',t.decision_id,'status',t.status,'decisionResultId',t.decision_result_id,'createdAt',t.created_at) from private.support_appeals_v5 t join private.support_cases_v5 c on c.id=t.case_id where t.account_id=p_account_id and c.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownSupportEvidence',jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'caseId',t.case_id,'eventId',t.event_id,'reference',t.snapshot,'createdAt',t.created_at,'bytesIncluded',false) from private.support_evidence_v5 t join private.support_cases_v5 c on c.id=t.case_id where t.submitted_by_account_id=p_account_id and c.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownSupportCommands',jsonb_build_object('kind',t.kind,'state',t.state,'caseId',t.case_id,'createdAt',t.created_at) from private.support_commands_v5 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownSupportReadMarkers',jsonb_build_object('caseId',t.case_id,'sequence',t.sequence::text,'updatedAt',t.updated_at) from private.support_read_markers_v5 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownAgreementPhotos',jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'agreementId',t.agreement_id,'agreementVersion',t.agreement_version,'messageId',t.attached_message_id,'state',t.state,
 'width',t.width,'height',t.height,'byteSize',t.byte_size,'createdAt',t.created_at,'cancelledAt',t.cancelled_at,'bytesIncluded',false) from private.agreement_photo_uploads_v5 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownAgreementVoice',jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'agreementId',t.agreement_id,'agreementVersion',t.agreement_version,'messageId',t.attached_message_id,'state',t.state,
 'durationMs',t.duration_ms,'byteSize',t.byte_size,'createdAt',t.created_at,'cancelledAt',t.cancelled_at,'bytesIncluded',false) from private.agreement_voice_uploads_v1 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownErasureSteps',jsonb_build_object('generation',t.generation,'ordinal',t.ordinal,'state',t.state,'rowsChanged',t.affected_rows,'verifiedAt',t.verified_at) from private.closure_redaction_steps_v5 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
 union all select key,value from private.closure_taxonomy_export_rows_v1(p_account_id) union all select 'needRequirements',jsonb_build_object('needId',t.need_id,'criticalConditions',t.critical_conditions,'handoff',t.handoff) from public.need_requirement_details t join public.needs n on n.id=t.need_id where n.requester_account_id=p_account_id),
 projected as (select r.key,(select jsonb_object_agg(field,r.value->field order by field) from jsonb_array_elements_text(c.config->'fields') field) as value
 from owned_rows r join configured c on c.config->>'key'=r.key and c.config->>'mode'='INCLUDE'),
 grouped as (select c.config->>'key' as key,coalesce(jsonb_agg(p.value order by p.value::text) filter(where p.key is not null),'[]'::jsonb) as rows
 from configured c left join projected p on p.key=c.config->>'key' where c.config->>'mode'='INCLUDE' group by c.config->>'key')
 select jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion','USKOCI_DATA_EXPORT_V2','receiptId',p_receipt_id,'accountId',p_account_id,'snapshotAt',p_cutoff,
 'projectionVersion','OWN_ACCOUNT_V5_11','policy',jsonb_build_object('policyId',p_binding->'policyId','policyVersion',p_binding->'policyVersion','privacyDocumentId',p_binding->'privacyDocumentId','privacyContentSha256',p_binding->'privacyContentSha256','sha256',p_binding->'sha256'),
 'datasets',(select jsonb_object_agg(key,rows order by key) from grouped),

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_ai_document(cid uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion','WORKER_PROFILE_V1','conversationId',s.conversation_id,'accountId',s.account_id,
  'profileId',s.profile_id,'status',c.status,'profileStatus',coalesce((select p.profile_status from public.app_profiles p where p.id=s.profile_id),'DRAFT'),
  'revision',s.revision,'candidate',s.candidate,'safety',s.safety,
  'stale',s.base_hash<>private.worker_ai_source_hash(s.account_id),
  'messages',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',m.id,'role',m.role,'body',m.body,'sequence',m.sequence_no) order by m.sequence_no)
    from (select * from public.ai_messages where conversation_id=cid order by sequence_no desc limit 100) m),'[]'::jsonb),
  'turn',(select private.worker_ai_turn_document(t.turn_id) from private.worker_ai_turns t where t.conversation_id=cid order by t.created_at desc,t.turn_id desc limit 1),
  'review',(select r.envelope from private.worker_ai_reviews r where r.conversation_id=cid AND NOT(r.envelope ? 'classificationState') order by
    exists(select 1 from private.worker_ai_saves z where z.review_id=r.id) desc,r.created_at desc,r.id desc limit 1),
  'saved',(select z.receipt from private.worker_ai_saves z join private.worker_ai_reviews r on r.id=z.review_id where r.conversation_id=cid AND NOT(r.envelope ? 'classificationState') limit 1))
 from private.worker_ai_sessions s join public.ai_conversations c on c.id=s.conversation_id and c.account_id=s.account_id and c.purpose='PROFILE'
 where s.conversation_id=cid;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_ai_service_mode_context_v1(p_account_id uuid, p_conversation_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 v_session private.worker_ai_sessions; v_profile_id uuid;
 v_item jsonb; v_projection jsonb; v_hints jsonb; v_source text; v_turn_resolved boolean:=false;
 v_saved_services jsonb:='[]';v_draft_services jsonb:='[]';v_unresolved jsonb:='[]';

BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO v_session FROM private.worker_ai_sessions
 WHERE account_id=p_account_id AND conversation_id=p_conversation_id;
 IF NOT FOUND OR v_session.base_hash IS DISTINCT FROM private.worker_ai_source_hash(p_account_id)
    OR jsonb_typeof(v_session.candidate->'skills') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_AI_NOT_EDITABLE' USING errcode='55000'; END IF;
 v_profile_id:=v_session.profile_id;
 -- Read only durable, active bindings for independently surviving services.
 -- A newer pending addition is not authority to erase an older bound service.
 -- Source hash above still ties this context to the current owned profile.
 WITH names AS (
  SELECT skill AS service,private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(skill) AS service_key
  FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(v_session.candidate->'skills') n(skill)
  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.app_profiles p WHERE p.id=v_profile_id
    AND p.account_id=p_account_id AND p.kind='WORKER' AND p.profile_status='ACTIVE'
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM unnest(p.skills) saved_skill
      WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(saved_skill)=private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(skill))=1)
 ), saved AS (
  SELECT s.*,r.envelope FROM private.worker_ai_saves s
  JOIN private.worker_ai_reviews r ON r.id=s.review_id AND r.account_id=s.account_id
  WHERE s.account_id=p_account_id AND s.receipt->>'profileId'=v_profile_id::text
   AND (EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 m WHERE m.worker_account_id=p_account_id
     AND m.active AND m.source_review_id=s.review_id AND m.source_request_key=s.client_request_id))
   AND s.receipt->>'accountId'=p_account_id::text AND s.receipt->>'reviewId'=r.id::text
   AND s.receipt->'saved'='true'::jsonb AND s.receipt->'authoritative'='true'::jsonb
   AND r.envelope->>'profileId'=v_profile_id::text AND r.envelope->>'accountId'=p_account_id::text
   AND r.envelope->>'reviewId'=r.id::text AND r.envelope->'canAccept'='true'::jsonb
   AND r.created_at<=s.created_at AND s.created_at<=r.expires_at
   AND r.envelope->>'displayedContentDigest'=encode(extensions.digest(
     ((r.envelope-'displayedContentDigest')||jsonb_build_object('baseHash',r.base_hash))::text,'sha256'),'hex')

 ), bound AS (
  SELECT n.service,m.execution_scope AS mode,m.handoff,c.id AS category_id
  FROM names n JOIN private.work_taxonomy_categories c ON c.state='ESTABLISHED'
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_category_modes cm ON cm.category_id=c.id
  JOIN private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 m ON m.category_id=c.id AND m.execution_scope=cm.execution_scope
   AND m.worker_account_id=p_account_id AND m.active
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities cap ON cap.category_id=c.id AND cap.worker_account_id=p_account_id
   AND NOT cap.excluded AND cap.origin='WORKER_CONFIRMED' AND cap.confirmed_at=m.confirmed_at AND cap.updated_at<=m.confirmed_at
  JOIN saved s ON s.review_id=m.source_review_id AND s.client_request_id=m.source_request_key
   AND s.envelope->>'classificationState'='READY'
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1 b ON b.owner_account_id=p_account_id
   AND b.profile_id=v_profile_id AND b.source_review_id=s.review_id AND b.request_key=s.client_request_id
   AND b.bound_at=m.confirmed_at AND b.bound_at>=s.created_at
   AND b.result->>'status'='BOUND_WORKER_SERVICES' AND b.result->>'workerProfileId'=v_profile_id::text
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_review_batches_v1 batch ON batch.owner_account_id=p_account_id
   AND batch.source_review_id=s.review_id AND batch.request_key=s.client_request_id AND batch.purpose='WORKER_CAPABILITY'
   AND batch.result->>'status'='COMMITTED' AND batch.result->'requiresBinding'='true'::jsonb
   AND batch.catalog_version=b.catalog_version AND batch.plans=s.envelope->'classificationCandidates'
   AND batch.review_digest=s.envelope->>'displayedContentDigest'
   AND jsonb_typeof(batch.plans)='array' AND jsonb_typeof(batch.result->'items')='array'
   AND b.result->'serviceModeCount'=to_jsonb(jsonb_array_length(batch.plans))
   AND jsonb_array_length(batch.result->'items')=jsonb_array_length(batch.plans)
   AND jsonb_array_length(s.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes')=jsonb_array_length(batch.plans)
  WHERE m.execution_scope IN ('ON_SITE','REMOTE')
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.worker_execution_mode_choices choice
    WHERE choice.worker_profile_id=v_profile_id AND choice.worker_account_id=p_account_id
     AND choice.consent_source='EXPLICIT_PROFILE_REVIEW' AND choice.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
     AND m.execution_scope=ANY(choice.modes))
   -- Compare the saved service key, preserving n.service for display. Formatting
   -- changes are not a new skill; arbitrary synonyms still require signed IDs.
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(s.envelope#>'{profile,skills}') skill(value)
     WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(skill.value)=n.service_key)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes') selected(value)
     WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(selected.value->>'service')=n.service_key
       AND selected.value->>'mode'=m.execution_scope)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(batch.result->'items') result(value)
     WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(result.value->>'service')=n.service_key
       AND result.value->>'mode'=m.execution_scope AND result.value->>'categoryId'=c.id::text)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(batch.plans) plan WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(plan->>'service')=n.service_key
    AND plan->>'mode'=m.execution_scope AND (plan->'handoff') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.handoff)
   AND (m.handoff IS NULL OR (m.execution_scope='REMOTE' AND private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(m.handoff)))
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM names same WHERE same.service_key=n.service_key)=1
   AND (
    -- Preserve exact/registered-alias resolution, including ambiguity refusal.
    ((c.canonical_key=n.service_key OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_aliases a
       WHERE a.category_id=c.id AND a.normalized_key=n.service_key))
     AND (SELECT count(*) FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories other WHERE other.state='ESTABLISHED'
      AND (other.canonical_key=n.service_key OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_aliases a
       WHERE a.category_id=other.id AND a.normalized_key=n.service_key)))=1)
    OR
    -- A local signed service may name an already-bound ID without a global alias.
    -- This branch only describes existing active authority; it never grants it.
    ((SELECT count(*) FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories other WHERE other.state='ESTABLISHED'
      AND (other.canonical_key=n.service_key OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_aliases a
       WHERE a.category_id=other.id AND a.normalized_key=n.service_key)))=0
     AND s.receipt->>'profileStatus'='ACTIVE'
     AND private.taxonomy_category_path_valid_v1(c.id)
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories child
       WHERE child.parent_id=c.id AND child.state='ESTABLISHED')
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(batch.plans) WITH ORDINALITY plan(value,ord)
       WHERE plan.value->>'action' IN ('REUSE_EXISTING','EXTEND_MODE')
        AND private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(plan.value->>'service')=n.service_key AND plan.value->>'mode'=m.execution_scope
        AND (plan.value->'handoff') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.handoff
        AND plan.value->>'categoryId'=c.id::text
        AND jsonb_typeof(plan.value->'categoryLabel')='string'
        AND c.label IS NOT DISTINCT FROM plan.value->>'categoryLabel'
        AND plan.value ? 'categoryParentId'
        AND coalesce(to_jsonb(c.parent_id),'null'::jsonb)
            IS NOT DISTINCT FROM plan.value->'categoryParentId'
        AND batch.result->'items'->(plan.ord::integer-1)->>'categoryId'=c.id::text
        AND batch.result->'items'->(plan.ord::integer-1)->>'mode'=m.execution_scope
        AND private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(batch.result->'items'->(plan.ord::integer-1)->>'service')=n.service_key))
   )

 ) SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT (jsonb_build_object('service',service,'mode',mode,
   'categoryId',category_id)||CASE WHEN handoff IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('handoff',handoff)
     ELSE '{}'::jsonb END)),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_saved_services FROM bound;

 -- Latest current-source hints are separate proposals. Even an exact category
 -- and mode here are not saved consent and must never replace the baseline.
 v_source:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(
   v_session.candidate::text||'|'||v_session.revision::text||'|'||v_session.base_hash,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');
 SELECT h.proposals,coalesce(h.catalog_resolution->>'state'='RESOLVED',false) INTO v_hints,v_turn_resolved FROM private.work_taxonomy_turn_hints_resolved_v1 h
 WHERE h.purpose='WORKER_CAPABILITY' AND h.account_id=p_account_id
   AND h.conversation_id=p_conversation_id AND h.source_fingerprint=v_source
   AND h.catalog_version=(SELECT catalog_version FROM private.work_taxonomy_control WHERE singleton=true)
 ORDER BY h.created_at DESC,h.id DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF jsonb_typeof(v_hints)='array' THEN
   FOR v_item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_hints) LOOP
     IF v_item->>'action' IS DISTINCT FROM 'REUSE_EXISTING'
        OR v_item->>'mode' NOT IN ('ON_SITE','REMOTE')
        OR v_item->>'categoryId' IS NULL
        OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_session.candidate->'skills') skill(value)
          WHERE skill.value=to_jsonb(v_item->>'service'))
        OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_session.candidate->'skills') skill(value)
            WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(skill.value#>>'{}')=
                  private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(v_item->>'service'))<>1
     THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
     v_projection:=private.taxonomy_review_exact_projection_v1('WORKER_CAPABILITY',
       jsonb_build_array(v_item->>'service'),jsonb_build_array(
         jsonb_build_object('service',v_item->>'service','mode',v_item->>'mode')));
     IF v_turn_resolved OR (v_projection->>'status'='READY'
        AND v_projection#>>'{classificationCandidates,0,categoryId}'=v_item->>'categoryId')
     THEN v_draft_services:=v_draft_services||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
       'service',v_item->>'service','mode',v_item->>'mode','categoryId',v_item->>'categoryId')
        ||case when v_item ? 'handoff' then jsonb_build_object('handoff',v_item->'handoff') else '{}'::jsonb end);
     END IF;
   END LOOP;
 END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value->>'service',value->>'mode',value->>'categoryId'),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO v_saved_services FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_saved_services)) rows;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value->>'service',value->>'mode',value->>'categoryId'),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO v_draft_services FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_draft_services)) rows;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value#>>'{}'),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_unresolved
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT skill.value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_session.candidate->'skills') skill(value)
   WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_saved_services||v_draft_services) known(value)
     WHERE known.value->>'service'=skill.value#>>'{}')) unresolved;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion','WORKER_SERVICE_MODE_CONTEXT_V1','revision',v_session.revision,
   'savedServices',v_saved_services,'draftServices',v_draft_services,'unresolvedServices',v_unresolved);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_ai_source(aid uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('profile',to_jsonb(p)-ARRAY['worker_dispatch_eligible_since','worker_dispatch_clock_source'],'location',private.worker_location_document(p.id),
  'availability',private.worker_availability_document(p.id),'capacity',private.worker_capacity_document(p.id),
  'workAreas',private.worker_saved_areas_v1(aid))
 from public.app_profiles p where p.account_id=aid and p.kind='WORKER';
$function$

constraints.name: ai_need_turn_cancelled_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((cancelled_at IS NULL) OR ((state = 'FAILED'::text) AND (receipt IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ai_need_turn_commands_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state <> 'PROCESSING'::text) OR ((attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (context_hash IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ai_test_reservations_v5_audio_measure_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((measured_audio_bytes IS NULL) AND (measured_transcript_chars IS NULL) AND (settlement_basis IS DISTINCT FROM 'AUDIO_DURATION_AT_PUBLISHED_RATE'::text)) OR ((kind = 'STT'::text) AND (measured_audio_bytes IS NOT NULL) AND (measured_audio_bytes > 0) AND (measured_transcript_chars IS NOT NULL) AND (measured_transcript_chars >= 0) AND (settlement_basis IS NOT NULL) AND (settlement_basis = ANY (ARRAY['AUDIO_DURATION_AT_PUBLISHED_RATE'::text, 'MEASURED'::text])))))

constraints.name: ai_test_reservations_v5_settlement_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((settled_microusd IS NULL) AND (settlement_basis IS NULL) AND (settled_at IS NULL)) OR ((settled_microusd IS NOT NULL) AND (settled_microusd >= 0) AND (settlement_basis IS NOT NULL) AND (settlement_basis = ANY (ARRAY['MEASURED'::text, 'CONSERVATIVE_ESTIMATE_UNMEASURED'::text, 'FAILED_NO_USAGE'::text, 'AUDIO_DURATION_AT_PUBLISHED_RATE'::text])) AND (settled_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: worker_ai_turn_cancelled_fence
constraints.definition: CHECK (((cancelled_at IS NULL) OR ((state = 'FAILED'::text) AND (completion_hash IS NULL))))
